mssp.title: MSSP
mssp.subtitle: Managed Security Services Platform
mssp.summary: A managed security services platform with an installable PWA and data-visualisation views.

caseStudy.scope: I was the only front-end developer on the project. I designed the full UI in Figma and built the entire front-end, including the installable PWA and the data-visualisation views.

payesh.title: Payesh
payesh.subtitle: Occupational Health Monitoring
payesh.summary: Multi-tenant, role-based dashboards for monitoring occupational health, with specialised medical forms.

caseStudy.context: Payesh monitors occupational health for multiple organisations. It provides multi-tenant, role-based dashboards; specialised medical form modules — organ-specific evaluations, audiometry, spirometry and lab panels; and multi-step onboarding wizards with dynamic, cascading form logic.

picopet.title: PicoPet
picopet.subtitle: Bilingual Veterinary Platform
picopet.summary: A bilingual veterinary platform for finding clinics and doctors, with visit history and role-based dashboards.

caseStudy.context: PicoPet is a bilingual veterinary platform covering clinic and doctor discovery, visit history and role-based dashboards, with full RTL/LTR internationalisation.

salam-operator.title: Salam Operator
salam-operator.subtitle: National Healthcare Platform
salam-operator.summary: A national healthcare platform for the Ministry of Health: telemedicine, appointment scheduling and patient records.

caseStudy.context: Salam Operator is a national healthcare platform for Iran's Ministry of Health. It covers telemedicine screens, video and text appointment scheduling, and patient health records.

ganotic.title: Ganotic
ganotic.subtitle: Health & Wellness E-commerce
ganotic.summary: My own health and wellness store: a Next.js PWA storefront, a React admin panel and a shared component library.

caseStudy.context: Ganotic is a health and wellness e-commerce business that I founded. This case study covers my front-end and design work only.
caseStudy.scope: I designed and built the front-end of both apps: a Next.js storefront shipped as an installable, SEO-focused PWA with a fully RTL Persian UI, and a React admin panel. Both apps share a Tailwind component library built on design tokens.

sepehr-pharmacy.title: Sepehr Online Pharmacy
sepehr-pharmacy.subtitle: Online pharmacy
sepehr-pharmacy.summary: Redesigned the pharmacist and admin UIs, refactored legacy screens into reusable components and fixed ordering-flow defects.

sepehr-salamat.title: Sepehr Salamat
sepehr-salamat.subtitle: Medical Centers Management
sepehr-salamat.summary: Rebuilt the doctor, receptionist and patient panels as shared components, redesigned the UI and fixed defects.
